lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with a higher density and smaller diameter of spots in the region immediately posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, with primary spots serving as nodes at the intersection of these vertical bands and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are present; the uppermost ridge shows the strongest intensity gradient, while a mid-lateral ridge bisects the main field of vertical stripes.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-8 high-luminance circular blobs are visible within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin silhouette, arranged in an irregular vertical distribution.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a commensal fish (remora) attached ventrally near the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
